title: Ziyarat Rajabiyya
intro: A ziyarat for visiting the holy shrines during Rajab, the seventh month of the Islamic calendar.
description: Read Ziyarat Rajabiyya with arabic text, transliteration and english meaning, recitation context and source references.

blocks.text:
Shaykh al-Tusi has also reported the following words from Abu’l-Qasim ibn Ruh, the special Representative of Imam al-Mahdi (atfs):
“In Rajab, you may visit any of the shrines (of the Holy Infallibles) that are possible for you to visit, and say the ziyarah therein:

×

from Sahifa Mahdivia(atfs)

Recited at any shrine of Ahlulbayt(as) in month of Rajab

Shaykh al-Tusi(ar) has also reported the following words from Abu’l-Qasim ibn Ruh, the special Representative of Imam al-Mahdi (atfs):
“In Rajab, you may visit any of the shrines (of the Holy Infallibles) that are possible for you to visit, and say the following therein:

blocks.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِي اشْهَدَنَا مَشْهَدَ اوْلِيَائِهِ فِي رَجَبٍ
blocks.transliteration: alhamdu lillahi alladhi ashhadana mashhada awliya'ihi fi rajabin
blocks.english: All praise be to Allah Who has allowed us to visit the shrine of His Saints in Rajab

blocks.arabic: وَاوْجَبَ عَلَيْنَا مِنْ حَقِّهِمْ مَا قَدْ وَجَبَ
blocks.transliteration: wa awjaba `alayna min haqqihim ma qad wajaba
blocks.english: and made obligatory upon us fulfilling our duties towards them.
May Allah send blessings to Muhammad, the divinely selected,
and upon his Successors—the doors to Him.
O Allah, just as You have allowed us to visit their shrines,
please do fulfill for us the promises You have made with them,
include us with them,
and include us with those whom shall not be prevented from drinking from the (Divine) Pool
in the abode of eternity and perpetuity.
Peace be upon you all.
I have turned my face towards you and directed to you
carrying my request and need with me,

blocks.transliteration: wa hiya fakaku raqabati mina alnnari
blocks.english: which is the release of my neck from Hellfire
and the settlement with you in the Abode of Final Settlement
with your pious adherents (Shi`ah).
Peace be upon you all for that you persevered in patience.
Now how excellent is the final home!

blocks.arabic: انَا سَائِلُكُمْ وَآمِلُكُمْ فِيمَا إِلَيْكُمُ ٱلتَّفْوِيضُ
blocks.transliteration: ana sa'ilukum wa amilukum fima ilaykumu alttafwidu
blocks.english: I hereby beg you and put my hope in you as regards the matters in which you have the right to act
and recompense.
Truly, through you only are the hopeless restored to good condition,
the ailed healed,

blocks.transliteration: wa ma tazdadu al-arhamu wa ma taghidu
blocks.english: and that which the wombs absorb and that which they grow.
Verily, I have full faith in your Secret
and I am fully submissive to your words;
I thus beg you in the name of Allah
to make me return having my requests responded,
met, accepted,
given success, and settled,
and set aright all my needs and all my affairs towards you.
Peace be upon you from one who bids you farewell
and puts all his needs with you,
praying to Allah for another visit to you,
since his hope is never cut off from you.

blocks.arabic: وَانْ يَرْجِعَنِي مِنْ حَضْرَتِكُمْ خَيْرَ مَرْجِعٍ
blocks.transliteration: wa an yarji`ani min hadratikum khayra marji`in
blocks.english: I also pray Him to make my departure successful
to a productive place,
a fruitful area,

blocks.transliteration: wa da`atin wa mahalin ila hini al-ajali
blocks.english: comfort, and luxurious up to the befalling of death.

blocks.arabic: وَخَيْرِ مَصِيرٍ وَمَحَلٍّ فِي ٱلنَّعِيمِ ٱلازَلِ
blocks.transliteration: wa khayri masirin wa mahallin fi alnna`imi al-azali
blocks.english: I also pray Him for the best destiny and abode in the Eternal Bliss,
the affluent living,
the perpetual fruit,
the drinking from the pure drink,

blocks.arabic: وَعَلٍّ وَنَهَلٍ لا سَامَ مِنْهُ وَلاَ مَلَلَ
blocks.transliteration: wa `allin wa nahalin la sa'ama minhu wa la malala
blocks.english: and the divine spring whose drink is refreshing and thirst-quenching that is never bored or fed up.

blocks.transliteration: wa rahmatu allahi wa barakatuhu wa tahiyyatuhu `alaykum
blocks.english: Allah’s mercy, blessings, and salutations be upon you incessantly
until I return to your presence
and win the honor of visiting you again
and the honor of being resurrected with your group.

blocks.arabic: وَرَحْمَةُ ٱللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَصَلَوَاتُهُ وَتَحِيَّاتُهُ
blocks.transliteration: wa rahmatu allahi wa barakatuhu `alaykum wa salawatuhu wa tahiyyatuhu
blocks.english: Allah’s mercy, blessings, benedictions, and salutations be upon you,

blocks.transliteration: wa huwa hasbuna wa ni`ma alwakilu
blocks.english: for Allah alone is Sufficient for us! Most Excellent is He in Whom we trust!

urduGuidance: یہ صفحہ زیارت رجبیہ کے لیے ہے۔ عربی متن اصل قراءت کے لیے ہے اور رومن تلفظ پڑھنے میں مدد دیتا ہے۔ انگریزی معنی الگ درج ہیں۔ ماخذ اور دوسری زیارات کے روابط صفحے کے آخر میں دیے گئے ہیں۔
